title: 10th Anniversary – 500K Community Check-Ins
description: To celebrate 10 years of Pokémon GO, Trainers can redeem this promo code for 10 Max Mushrooms, unlocked by the community reaching 500,000 worldwide check-ins at community meetups. The code is expected to expire after Pokémon GO Wild Area ends, but the expiration date has not been confirmed.

title: LEGO × Pokémon GO Berries
description: Promo code for free berries and Poké Balls tied to the Pokémon GO and LEGO Group partnership. Learn more[here](https://leekduck.com/events/lego-pokemon-go-2026/).

title: adidas Shoes Avatar Item
description: Complete your outfit with a pair of adidas shoes for your avatar! Redeem this promo code in the Pokémon GO Web Store by Friday, January 15, 2027.
